# Velkina

> Velkina is a Turkish-Romanian software, design and growth agency building websites, e-commerce, AI customer agents, cloud infrastructure, mobile apps and restaurant QR menus for businesses across İstanbul, Bucharest and Berlin. One senior team across software, design and growth. Trilingual delivery (EN / TR / RO), no handover to juniors after signing, code and accounts stay in the client's name.

Velkina operates as a fixed-scope project shop, sprint partner or monthly retainer. Weekly demos with real preview links, honest scope, honest pricing, honest timelines. Common engagements pair a website or store with the Google or Meta ads that run on top of it, so one team is accountable for both build and growth.

## Services

- [Websites & landing pages](https://www.velkina.com/en/services#websites): Custom Next.js / React sites and landing pages, mobile-first, multilingual, with copy in your language, schema-rich SEO foundations and a CMS for owner edits. Loads in under a second.
- [Shopify e-commerce](https://www.velkina.com/en/services#shopify): Conversion-optimized Shopify stores — custom themes, multilingual setup, payment and shipping, email flows (abandoned cart, welcome, win-back), Pixel + GA4 + Meta CAPI.
- [Restaurant QR menus](https://www.velkina.com/en/services#qr-menu): Mobile-first QR menus with photos, allergen tags, dietary labels, 5+ languages, per-table QR codes, call-waiter and request-bill actions, plus an admin panel the owner uses from a phone.
- [Google Ads management](https://www.velkina.com/en/services#google-ads): Managed Search, Display, Shopping and YouTube campaigns with structured accounts, GA4 + enhanced conversion tracking, weekly optimization and honest monthly reporting.
- [Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)](https://www.velkina.com/en/services#meta-ads): Pixel + Conversions API setup, audience research, weekly creative testing (static and video — produced in-house), catalogue ads and trustworthy post-iOS14 attribution.
- [Cloud management & DevOps](https://www.velkina.com/en/services#cloud): AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel and Cloudflare — architecture review, migration plans, CI/CD, monitoring, backups, disaster recovery and cost optimization.
- [AI automation & agents](https://www.velkina.com/en/services#ai-automation): Custom AI agents on OpenAI / Anthropic for customer service, lead routing, document processing and internal Q&A — integrated with CRM, email and Sheets, with monitoring dashboards and monthly tuning.
- [Mobile apps (iOS & Android)](https://www.velkina.com/en/services#mobile): React Native or fully native iOS / Android builds — App Store and Play Store submission, push notifications, deep links, crash reporting and OTA updates.
- [SEO & content](https://www.velkina.com/en/services#seo): Technical SEO audits, schema and structured data, keyword and topic research, content plans with briefs, on-page optimization and optional backlink outreach across 3 languages.
- [Branding & design systems](https://www.velkina.com/en/services#branding): Logo (3 directions, 5 revisions), color and typography system, voice and tone guide, brand guidelines PDF, design tokens (Figma + code), social and print templates.

## Case studies

- [Lavinia Bistro — QR Menu](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/lavinia-bistro-qr-menu): Photo-rich, multilingual QR menu for a 60-seat Istanbul bistro. Loads under 1s on 4G, 5 languages (TR/EN/DE/RU/AR), allergen tags, call-waiter and request-bill actions; tourist attach-rate on desserts and drinks rose 38% and the owner edits everything from her phone.
- [Rain Group — Home Décor Shopify](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/rain-group-ecommerce): Premium custom Shopify theme for a home textiles brand, multilingual (TR/EN) with international shipping. DTC channel launched in 6 weeks; organic traffic +60% in Q1; Meta Ads ROAS settled at 3.4x after creative testing.
- [Dr. Sevim Aydın Beauty](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/drsevim-beauty-clinic): Trust-driven aesthetic-clinic website with integrated online booking and SEO foundations. Organic visibility +40%, mobile sessions reached 70% of traffic, clinic books new patients online every week.
- [TP Thermoplast — B2B Manufacturing](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/tp-thermoplast-b2b): Multilingual (TR/EN/DE) B2B site for a 20-year plastics exporter with a structured product catalog, spec-sheet downloads and industrial inquiry forms. Page-load time cut by 50% and international inquiry volume grew measurably.
- [EduTurkia — Student Platform](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/eduturkia-platform): Custom education consultancy platform — student records, university catalog, application pipeline, admin panel and CRM integration. Student tracking went 100% digital; parents now check progress on their own dashboard.
- [Clown 3D — Creative Studio](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/clown3d-creative-studio): Playful site for a 3D design and visualization studio with scroll-driven 3D reveals and a portfolio organized by sector. SEO integration drove inbound enquiries from international agencies.
- [Atar Avcı — Law Firm](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/ataravci-law-firm): Minimal personal-brand site for a law practice with plain-language service pages (no legalese) and SEO on commercial legal terms. Higher inquiry conversion; the site became a credibility check for every referral.
- [Anatolia Hotel — Direct Bookings](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/anatolia-hotel-booking): Direct-booking website with integrated booking engine, Google Ads on brand and high-intent terms, and an email program for past guests. Direct bookings rose to 28% of total volume; OTA commission cost dropped by a third.
- [Nova Health — AWS Migration](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/novahealth-cloud-migration): Migration from creaky shared hosting to AWS (ECS + RDS + S3 + CloudFront) with CloudWatch + Sentry monitoring, daily backups with point-in-time restore and an incident runbook. Uptime climbed from ~95% to 99.95% at lower total cost.
- [Bosporus Travel — AI Customer Agent](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/bosporus-travel-ai-agent): Custom AI agent on the WhatsApp Business API trained on tours, prices and FAQs in 4 languages (EN/TR/DE/AR). Handles 80% of inbound messages autonomously; response time dropped from 4 hours to 30 seconds.
- [Skyline Media — Mobile App](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/skyline-media-mobile-app): React Native iOS + Android app for a media subscription service with offline-first content sync, push notifications and a short-session recommendation feed. DAU 3× higher than web in Q1; push opt-in at 62%.
- [Marmara Foods — Google Ads Growth](https://www.velkina.com/en/use-cases/marmara-foods-google-ads): Managed Google Ads program (Search + Shopping + remarketing) with restructured account themes, enhanced conversions and server-side events. Account ROAS settled at 4.2x; CPA dropped 31% in 90 days.
